svg.title: Froni Edition One, interior hood verse, repeat unit
svg.desc: EB Garamond italic. X-height fixed at 7 mm. One repeat unit; the artboard tiles end to end and the 20 mm trailing space is part of the unit. Escalation to 8 or 9 mm x-height is a strike-off decision with densities retuned. Fill C9A227, marigold family, thread shade decided at strike-off.
